summary: Daily iOS builds receive signed Expo updates through their paired gateway using short-lived app/channel tokens; local publishers use st app-updates publish.

replay.detail: No existing claims need replay. Publication metadata uses new custom.app-update.published claims; native-build-required receipts are node-local observations.

schema.detail: No database migration is needed. The claim registry adds app-update.native-build-required with local retention; immutable update objects live in the managed app-updates-v1 directory.

rules.detail: No fleet coordination rules change. Update publishing is exposed only on the local Unix socket.

compatibility.detail: New pairings grant read.app-updates. Existing paired clients need a new pairing grant to mint update tokens. Only compatible runtimeVersion manifests are served; older compatible updates remain available.

downtime.detail: Restart st3 to register the update routes. Restarting invalidates derived update tokens, which the daily client renews using its Keychain pairing credential. Restart downtime has not been measured.

manual.detail: Generate a deployer-owned signing pair outside source control, supply the public certificate through ST_IOS_UPDATES_CERT and install a daily Release native build. Daily fails closed without this setting. The private key remains only with the publisher. Export, sign and publish with the commands in apps/ios/README.md.

recovery.detail: Expo embedded/cached recovery and anti-bricking protections remain enabled. Immutable manifests and their referenced assets are never evicted; publishing refuses the configured fixed capacity rather than break old manifests.
